## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (for example `fix(server): ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] Documentation updated for any user-visible change (`npm run docs:check` passes)
- [ ] `npm run privacy-check` passes, and the diff contains no secrets, real emails, absolute user paths, hostnames, IP addresses or tailnet names
- [ ] Any new `.privacy-allowlist` entry is an obviously fake fixture value
